messages:
elaine: FYI my migration PR for the new embeddings config failed the docs preview. Multiple lint errors (linkcheck + remark + vale). Dumping CI output here.

ci-bot: docs-preview failed on 2141694321
ci-bot: summary: linkcheck (1 dead external, 1 missing anchor), remark-lint (MD033 inline html), spellcheck (2), vale (prose/terminology)

mike: paste the linkcheck lines? I can fix the dead URL if it's external.

elaine: linkcheck: `ERROR: Dead link https://docs.oldsite/embeddings-examples -> 404` and `ERROR: Anchor not found #client-examples in docs/migrations/migration-embeddings.md`

sophie: the anchor was renamed when I moved that section. Two options: update the internal link to the slug or add an explicit HTML anchor like `<!-- #client-examples -->`. Prefer updating the link to match the new heading slug.

luis: MD033 is from an inline HTML comment used for a callout. Remark wants fenced callouts instead. Quick fix: replace the HTML callout with a blockquote and a small admonition code block.

mike: vale is complaining about "embedder" again. Style guide prefers "embedding model" or "embedding service" depending on context. Do we normalize in this PR?

sophie: keep this PR scoped to the migration doc only. If we do a repo-wide replace it's a nontrivial review. Create a ticket for the global sweep.

elaine: ok I'll: 1) update the internal link to the exact heading slug, 2) swap the dead external link to the new examples host (https://examples.redwood.ai/embeddings-v2), 3) convert the inline HTML to markdown, 4) address the vale flags in this file only, and 5) run local lint.

mike: run locally with: `npm ci && npm run docs:format && npm run docs:lint` — the pipeline uses the same commands. Also `npx vale --config .vale.ini docs/migrations/migration-embeddings.md` for quick vale checks.

(15 minutes)

elaine: pushed changes. Triggered preview.

ci-bot: docs-preview started for PR #4780

ci-bot: linkcheck: passed
ci-bot: remark-lint: passed (MD033 fixed)
ci-bot: spellcheck: 1 remaining ("paramters")
ci-bot: vale: warning: prefer "embedding model" over "embedder" (2 occurrences)

mike: I'll fix that last typo and change the two occurrences of embedder in the doc to embedding model. I'll exclude sweeping the rest of the repo.

luis: can we add a tiny unit in docs CI that asserts internal links resolve to slugs case-insensitively? This anchor rename slipped because of casing.

sophie: agreed, small CI test would save future churn. I'll add a check in the linkcheck job to normalize anchor case before lookup. Opened a small PR for that change.

mike: pushed typo + terminology fixes. Re-ran preview.

ci-bot: docs-preview rerun for PR #4780: all checks passed 

elaine: sweet. Who merges? We should avoid the daily release window.

sophie: suggest merging at 17:00 PT during the docs quiet window. I'll coordinate with release-engineer if anything else is queued.

luis: filed follow-up DOCS-541 for repo-wide "embedder" -> "embedding model" sweep and DOCS-542 to add the anchor-case test to linkcheck.

elaine: PR merged at 2141694600. Thanks everyone.

mike: added a note to the PR about not touching unrelated files and linking DOCS-541/DOCS-542.

sophie: noted for release notes: "Embeddings migration doc updated; internal links and examples fixed."
